senses.gloss: to draw a circle; denom. כַּרְכּוֹם II.
(cmp. כְּרוּם) to paint, varnish; to polish, bronze.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:2">Kel. XV, 2</cite> <he>סירקן או כִרְכְּמָן</he> if he painted or varnished the boards.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:9">Ib. XXII, 9</cite> <he>כופת שסירקו או כִרְכְּמוֹ וכ׳</he> a block which one painted or varnished so as to give it a distinguishable surface.
<cite ref="Chullin 25b">Ḥull. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>לכַרְכֵּם</he> Ar. to polish or bronze (metal vessels), v. <cite ref="K01191"><he>כִּרְכֵּב</he></cite>.

Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 1 ואם … לכרכם עד שיְכַרְכֵּם if he intends to varnish (the leather goods), they cannot become unclean until he has varnished them. Cant. R. beg. סיתתה וכִירְכְּמָהּ he chiseled and polished the stone, v. מָרַק.—כ׳ פנים [to braze the face,] to be bold, defiant (cmp. יָרַק). Y’lamd. to Num. XX, 8 quot. in Ar. והוא מְכִרְכֵּם פניו כנגדן (some ed. Ar. מכרכס, (v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v.) and he (Moses) defied them; Yalk. Num. 763 נִתְכַּרְכְּמוּ פניו, v. infra.—Part. pass. מְכוּרְכָּם פנים מְכוּרְכָּמוֹת; green, pale face.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> <he>יצאו ופניהם מכ׳</he> they went out pale-faced (abashed).—Denom. <cite ref="K01197"><he>כַּרְכּוֹם</he> I</cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of <cite ref="K01197"><he>כַּרְכּוֹם</he> I</cite>, cmp. <cite ref="J00653"><he>יָרַק</he></cite>), with <he>פנים</he>

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>נִתְכַּרְכְּמוּ פניו</he> he turned pale. Y. Snh. I, 19ᵃ bot. Pesik. Par. p. 38ᵃ; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite> (some ed. <he>נתכרמו</he>, corr. acc.).—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:27">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 35</cite> <he>ופניו מִתְכַּרְכְּמִין</he> and his (Abraham’s) face turned pale (from jealousy); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 162:1">Yalk. Sam. 162</cite> <he>ופני אברהם מִתְכַּרְכְּמוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>נתכ׳ פניו</he> his face was tanned (from exposure to the sun; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982">Yalk. ib. 982</cite> <cite ref="Q00478"><he>נפחם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 763">Yalk. Num. 763</cite>, v. supra.
